summary: Frontend-only test of new massive feature set (admin fingerprint enroll card, 3-tab AdminPanel with Users + Verification, ban/unban with reason toast on login, verify approve/reject with notifications, guardian-verified badge, and Cormorant-font cleanup on numeric displays). 31 assertions PASS, 2 FAIL. All new admin flows work end-to-end (seed user → wallet edit shows 250 immediately, ban writes 'محظور' tag, banned login toast shows 'نشاط مشبوه' & rejects login, verify approve flips isVerified=true and removes from pending list, guardian reject stores reason and pushes guardian_rejected notification, notification bell renders verify_approved + guardian_rejected reason for the tester, guardian-verified-badge renders ONLY when guardianVerified=true, admin-fp-card visible for admin & hidden for non-admin, admin-fp-enroll button present when not enrolled). 2 real bugs found: (a) UNBAN does not refresh UI — the 'محظور' tag remains visible after clicking user-ban-* on an already-banned user (works in localStorage but stale UI); (b) exchange-received-display still uses fontFamily 'Cormorant Garamond' — not cleaned up in AppExchange.jsx L253.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking user-ban-* on an already-banned user calls unbanUser() correctly (localStorage.trycash_users.<email>.banned becomes false) BUT the row keeps rendering the 'محظور' tag [data-testid=user-banned-<email>]. Root cause: `const users = useMemo(() => getAllUsers(), [modal])` depends ONLY on `modal` state; unban path doesn't open a modal, so the memoized users list stays stale even after parent tick+refreshCurrent. The BAN path works because opening the ban-modal changes `modal` and forces the memo to recompute after close.

exchange-received-display still has inline style fontFamily: "'Cormorant Garamond', serif" — violates the numeric-cleanup requirement. Fix: remove the fontFamily entry from the style prop on the <div data-testid="exchange-received-display"> at AppExchange.jsx L251-256.

action_items: Fix UNBAN stale UI in AdminPanel.jsx > UsersSection: change `useMemo(() => getAllUsers(), [modal])` to depend on a bump counter (e.g. add `const [bump, setBump] = useState(0)` and include `bump` in deps; increment bump inside the unban onClick after unbanUser()). Or simpler: replace useMemo with a state that is re-set in a small effect keyed by [modal, tick] and pass `tick` prop into UsersSection.
Remove `fontFamily: "'Cormorant Garamond', serif"` from the style prop on [data-testid=exchange-received-display] (AppExchange.jsx L253) to comply with the numeric de-decoration requirement.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPanel.jsx: `refresh()` in parent bumps tick but child UsersSection/VerifySection each use `useMemo(..., [modal])` internally — unrelated to parent tick. Any refresh-triggered admin state that doesn't open a modal (unban, or verify actions that call setModal(null) but might be racy) risks stale views. Recommend hoisting `tick` (or a `bump`) down as a prop and including it in the useMemo dep array — this is exactly the same class of bug fixed in iterations 3–4 for wallets modal but on a different code path.

AdminFingerprintModal auto-switches to question mode when no credential — verified working, but there is no [data-testid=fp-modal] `mode` label; tests still had to try fp-answer first, then fallback to fp-cant. Minor: consider a testid like `fp-mode=question` for clarity.

webauthn.js correctly stores base64url credential id in `trycash_admin_webauthn`; enroll/verify code is well-structured; note that this is inherently untestable in headless Chrome without a virtual authenticator (documented in problem statement).

NotificationBell.jsx: renders verify_approved / verify_rejected / guardian_approved / guardian_rejected correctly, including the admin's reason text; icon color-coding is appropriate (emerald for approved, rose for rejected). No bug.

AuthContext.jsx: banUser/unbanUser/approveUserId/rejectUserId/approveGuardian/rejectGuardian all correctly write to USERS_KEY and refresh AUTH_KEY when target is current session user. login() returns {error:'banned', banReason} — verified working via toast in Login.jsx.
AppPersonalInfo.jsx guardian-verified-badge correctly gated by `current.guardianVerified` — verified in both truthy and falsy branches.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Two fixes required: (1) UsersSection unban UI staleness — parent tick doesn't reach child useMemo; recommend adding a bump/tick prop into child. (2) exchange-received-display Cormorant Garamond inline fontFamily. Everything else in the massive feature set works — including WebAuthn hookup (button visibility only), 3 tabs, all CRUD user actions, verification approve/reject with notifications, ban/unban with reason toast on login, guardian-verified badge, and Cormorant cleanup on ALL other numeric surfaces (wallet-mini, active-balance-amount, admin-wallet-amt-*, rate-val-*, exchange-amount-input). Session-persistence hack for tests: after admin login via UI, subsequent navigations preserved 'trycash_current_user' in localStorage; when needed to switch to tester, we overwrite trycash_current_user directly and reload — this bypass proved reliable. Guardian test IDs use short suffix: view-g-<email>, approve-g-<email>, reject-g-<email> (NOT view-guardian-...); the modal/reason inputs use the FULL form: [data-testid=reject-modal-guardian-<email>] / [data-testid=reject-reason-guardian-<email>] / [data-testid=reject-confirm-guardian-<email>]. Reject-id path uses kind='id' consistently.
rca_of_the_issue: BUG-UNBAN-STALE-UI: In AdminPanel.jsx > UsersSection, the users list is memoized as `useMemo(() => getAllUsers(), [modal])`. The BAN path works because clicking ban opens a modal (modal state changes twice: null→ban→null); each transition invalidates the memo. The UNBAN path calls `unbanUser(u.email)` synchronously inline WITHOUT changing `modal`, so the memo re-uses the previously-computed users array containing `banned:true`. Fix: add a bump/tick prop from parent (already exposed via `refresh()`) into UsersSection and include it in the useMemo deps, OR replace useMemo with a useEffect+useState pair keyed on that same tick. BUG-EXCHANGE-CORMORANT: The div at AppExchange.jsx L251-256 (data-testid=exchange-received-display) still has `fontFamily: "'Cormorant Garamond', serif"` in its inline style — cleanup pass missed this element. Fix is a one-line style removal.
